screen.nocroptrample.title: No Crop Trample Config
screen.nocroptrample.option.empty.toolti: Prevent empty (unplanted) farmland from being trampled into dirt.
screen.nocroptrample.option.player.toolt: Prevent players (and player-controlled mounts) from trampling planted farmland.
screen.nocroptrample.option.mob.tooltip: Prevent mobs from trampling planted farmland.
screen.nocroptrample.option.feather_fall: Require boots with at least this Feather Falling level for player trampling protection.
screen.nocroptrample.option.fall_distanc: Falls higher than this distance still trample farmland. Set to Unlimited for full protection.
screen.nocroptrample.remote.readonly: You cannot change server settings here. Showing current server settings:
screen.nocroptrample.remote.command_hint: Server operators can change settings with /nocroptrample.
screen.nocroptrample.remote.legacy: You cannot change server settings here. This server runs an older version of No Crop Trample — use /nocroptrample status in chat to view its settings.
screen.nocroptrample.remote.not_installe: This server does not have No Crop Trample installed.
